foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose, and nothing here should change a treatment without your own clinician. Criteria, assessment tools and guideline statements are quoted as published and are for learning, not self-diagnosis. No medication is approved for BPD itself; drug evidence is reported as published. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: The BPD Companion is an educational synthesis of published literature for study and understanding. It does not replace a psychiatrist, psychologist, nurse or other clinician, and the criteria and questionnaires in it are teaching aids, not self-tests. No medication is approved for BPD itself; drug findings are reported as published. If you are in crisis or thinking about suicide, contact local emergency services or a crisis line (in the US call or text 988; in the UK and Ireland Samaritans 116 123).
shell.note: An animated, cited guide for students, people living with borderline personality disorder, and their families and carers. Educational only, not medical advice. Your place is saved on this device.
